def entry(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(s) != 24:
        return 4294967295
    if read64(s, 0) != 3544422312159826504 or read64(s, 8) != 1 or read64(s, 16) != 0:
        return 4294967295
    if length(o) < 1702:
        return 4294967294
    part_0(o)
    part_1(o)
    part_2(o)
    part_3(o)
    return 1702
